Overview

MaintMaster is a flexible CMMS built by maintenance professionals, for maintenance professionals. It is highly regarded in the European market for its visual interface, allowing users to navigate their plant and assets using pictures and visual maps rather than just text lists.

Best For: Manufacturing plants looking for a highly visual and adaptable maintenance system

Core Capabilities

Visual Interface

Use pictures and visual maps to navigate assets, making it incredibly intuitive for floor workers to locate machines.

Customizable Workflows

Adapt the system to your exact processes and terminology without needing to write any code.

Pros

  • Highly adaptable to specific plant needs and workflows
  • Built by maintenance professionals with real-world experience
  • Excellent visual navigation for assets

Cons

  • Pricing can be higher for smaller teams
  • Primarily focused on the European market, though expanding globally

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does MaintMaster cost?

MaintMaster starting plans begin at $50 per user per month. A free trial is available to evaluate features before committing.

How long does it take to implement MaintMaster?

Typical onboarding and deployment for MaintMaster takes approximately 2 to 4 weeks, depending on team scale and data migration needs.
